note: The configured tacmed.com.au URLs redirect to tacmedaustralia.com.au (see receipts' final_url); one page is the separate training.tacmed.com.au course site (TacMed Training). Most of the site is an online store for first aid and tactical medical supplies; simulation appears on pages_simulation only. Two store collection pages (radio harnesses, medical backpacks) contain no simulation content. The saved text of the four tacmedaustralia.com.au pages has an empty TITLE line; a page title appears as the last line instead.

product_category.value: Tactical and emergency medical equipment supplier (tourniquets, IFAKs, trauma kits) that also supplies tactical and clinical medical simulation equipment (human and K9 simulators, trauma task trainers, program support) and, through TacMed Training, accredited tactical medical courses

evidence.quote: Australia's trauma and tactical medical specialist. Tourniquets, IFAKs, trauma kits and chest seals.
Tactical and clinical medical simulation equipment for defence, emergency services and healthcare training. Human simulators, K9 trainers, trauma task trainers and program support
TacMed Training delivers scenario-driven, nationally accredited medical courses for military, mining, law enforcement, and first responders across Australia.

product_category.note: The simulation page presents TacMed as a supplier and program partner for simulation products ('We Design Programs, Not Just Supply Equipment.'), naming platforms such as the TOMManikin series and 'Tacmed Solutions Simulators'. It lists '6' 'Global Simulation Suppliers/ Manufacturers'.

evidence.quote: Human simulators, K9 trainers, trauma task trainers and program support

platforms.note: Simulation products are physical (full-body manikins, K9 simulators, task trainers, wearable wound systems, moulage, simulated evacuation platforms), recorded as Physical hardware. The quote is the simulation page's META DESCRIPTION. No Web, VR, AR, MR, Mobile or Desktop delivery is described. 'Environmental Sensory Simulation' is listed without detail.
